Norm.Introduction: Hi there. The name's Norm. Pleased to meet you.#$b#I'm not much for talking. I make food and sell it from my wagon. Stop by when I'm open.
Norm.Gift.Love.Generic: Hey, this is great stuff! Thank you!
Norm.Gift.Dislike.Generic: Thanks, but I don't like this.
Norm.Gift.Hate.Generic: Don't go bringing me any more of these. Got it?

Norm.Lacey.Gossip: You know, I see a lot of different kinds of folks, driving a food cart from place to place.#$b#But I ain't never seen a giant, walking, talking mouse before! Bit of a surprise, I tell ya what.#$b#Do you know her? She said she lives in the forest. Anyway, she bought five pretzels. She was real excited to see 'em.
